reason: Orchestration tools such as dispatch_note, dispatch_link and dispatch_talk are reached only through metaform_catalog, and the agent had to search for their exact names and then call them with a tool-and-arguments shape. A short class-level skill saves that discovery on every such call.
The first intent for this skill carried a placeholder token in its body, which the format spec forbids. This restates the same rule with the placeholder replaced by plain words.
Its catalog-call route is carried into the Calling dispatch tools through metaform_catalog section and references/notes-and-delivery.md.
